sights.n: Kouri Ocean Tower, Kouri Island (古宇利オーシャンタワー)
sights.w: A white observation tower on Kouri Island whose deck stands 82 m above sea level, looking over the cobalt sea and the Kouri Ōhashi bridge; Okinawa Traveler's northern-cafés feature recommends a meal there with the view. Listed by the OCVB and the Nakijin Village tourism association.
sights.k: 82 m above the sea, looking down the Kouri bridge
